text:
Carmen (PM): Quick sync—hosted API roadmap priorities for next quarter. Need to decide which features go GA vs experimental. Top asks: cheaper embeddings, chat latency SLO, reranker API.

Jules (Eng): Agree. Split into lanes: 1) latency/cost, 2) developer ergonomics, 3) enterprise controls. Helps prioritize cross-team work.

Ravi (ML Eng): From ML: embeddings quantized variants give ~2.5x cost reduction on bench but recall drops ~1–2% on our eval set. Need clear gating criteria before GA.

Maya (Product Ops): Proposed launch criteria:
- embeddings GA -> >=3x cost win OR <1% relative recall regression on canonical evals
- chat GA -> p50 <200ms on 2k-token traces + 99.9% success rate
- reranker GA -> >=20% improvement in P@1 on customer evals

Sam (Customer Success): Note two enterprise customers want per-org embedding namespaces + SSO + retention controls before migrating production.

Carmen (PM): Options: ship embeddings as "cost-optimized beta" self-serve, gate GA until per-org namespaces delivered. Vote?

Jules (Eng): Beta is reasonable, but runtime needs per-tenant cache partitioning — estimate ~2 sprints of infra work.

Ravi (ML Eng): We can do quantized model variant fallback and add continuous eval hooks. Rollout suggestion: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regressions.

Maya (Product Ops): Action items: 1) runbook for rollout, 2) console controls for toggling beta/ga, 3) docs on quality monitoring and rollback. Who owns the runbook?

Jules (Eng): I'll draft the runbook + infra checklist. ETA: end of week.

Sam (Customer Success): I'll collect enterprise legal/data-retention requirements and customer deadlines.

Carmen (PM): @deploy-bot any conflicts for canary windows? Could route canary traffic to Dedicated pool to isolate.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window with Dedicated pool stub. No conflicts with maintenance.

Ravi (ML Eng): Quick paste of eval numbers: baseline recall 0.912 -> quantized 0.900; latency 40ms -> 18ms. So ~1.3% absolute recall drop but ~2x latency/cost improvement.

Carmen (PM): Tradeoff summary: ~1.3% recall vs large cost/latency gains. Recommend beta release and lock GA to <1% recall-drop. Need tuning on quantization and maybe hybrid retrieval + embed reranking.

Maya (Product Ops): Decision recap:
- Embeddings: ship Beta (cost-optimized), GA gated on per-org namespaces + recall <1%.
- Chat: prioritize latency SLO work and streaming fixes for GA.
- Reranker: deprioritize GA unless a clear >=20% lift on customer evals.

Jules (Eng): Will break down tasks and estimates for sprint planning. Please add any must-have customer work to the sprint board.

Carmen (PM): I'll create the OKR mapping doc and post a link here. Rough OKRs for the quarter: reduce hosted token unit cost 30% (embeddings + batching), achieve chat p50 <200ms, onboard 2 enterprise customers to per-org namespaces.

Sam (Customer Success): :thumbsup: coordinating customer timelines and will flag hard deadlines.

Carmen (PM): Thanks all — I'll follow up with a doc and next steps. If anything urgent, DM me.
